description: This Kotlin source file defines a PhotosHandler class for managing photo retrieval in an Android app, including checking permissions, querying recent photos, resizing, encoding to JPEG, and returning photo data as JSON.

classes.name: PhotosLatestRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for fetching latest photos, including limit, maxWidth, and quality.

classes.name: EncodedPhotoPayload
classes.description: Data class representing encoded photo information including format, base64 data, dimensions, and creation date.

classes.name: PhotosDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checking and fetching latest photos.

classes.name: SystemPhotosDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing PhotosDataSource to fetch photos from the device's media store.

classes.name: PhotosHandler
classes.description: Main class handling photo retrieval requests, permission validation, photo querying, processing, encoding, and JSON response formation.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest
methods.description: Handles the photo retrieval request, checks permissions, parses input JSON, fetches photos, and returns a JSON payload.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a PhotosLatestRequest object, applying defaults and constraints.

methods.name: queryLatestRows
methods.description: Queries the media store to retrieve the most recent photo entries, limited by count.

methods.name: decodeScaledBitmap
methods.description: Decodes and scales a photo bitmap from its URI to fit the maximum width.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates the optimal sampling size for bitmap decoding based on target width.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a bitmap as JPEG, adjusting quality and size to stay within specified base64 size limits.
